name: quota-reset-index
description: Append-only, evidence-linked ledger of discretionary AI quota resets.

scripts.hooks:install: git config core.hooksPath .githooks && chmod +x .githooks/pre-commit && echo 'hooks installed (core.hooksPath=.githooks)'
scripts.test: node --test test/*.test.mjs status/__tests__/*.test.ts models/__tests__/*.test.ts usage/__tests__/*.test.ts site/__tests__/*.test.ts capture/__tests__/*.test.mjs social/__tests__/*.test.ts lib/__tests__/*.test.mjs
scripts.build:site: node site/build-methodology.ts && node site/build-ledger-page.ts && node site/build-forecast.ts && node site/build-compare.ts && node site/headers.ts && node site/robots.ts && node site/sitemap.ts
scripts.build: npm run build:ledger && npm run build:site
